summary: Phase D Section T (Audit Trail, System Health, Search Performance) fully tested — backend + frontend + RBAC. 8/8 new Section T tests passed. Full regression suite: 99/100 passed (the 1 failure is the pre-existing known flaky test_qualify_updates_score_status due to shared session-scoped seed_lead fixture, documented in the review request — NOT a bug).
critical_code_review_comments: AuditController::index uses `where auditable_type like %Lead%` — works but a namespaced-class exact match would be more precise (Lead vs OldLead). Acceptable for current scope.
AuditController::performance limits to 25 rows before measuring — probe is realistic but note the acceptance target of <2s @ 100K leads must be validated manually (crm:seed-leads 100000).
test_credentials: admin@crm.local/Admin@12345 (admin), marketing@crm.local/Demo@12345 (has config.manage), rahul@crm.local/Demo@12345 (Sales Exec, no config.manage)
seed_data_creation: Ran `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed --force` before pytest suite as instructed. Section T tests create 1 lead per module run (TEST_T_ prefix). No 100K seed run performed (per instructions).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Section T endpoints verified working: GET /api/v1/audit-logs (paginated, filters action/auditable_type/auditable_id/user_id/from/to), GET /api/v1/system/health (returns communications/automation/integrations[6, all live=false]/recent_errors), GET /api/v1/system/performance?q=lead (elapsed_ms=0.2ms on fresh DB, within_target=true). RBAC verified: admin+marketing 200, rahul(exec) 403 on all three. Frontend nav-health & nav-audit visible only for users with config.manage; hidden for Sales Exec. Health page renders health-cards, health-integrations table (6 rows all showing MOCK chips), and 'No recent errors' empty state. Audit page renders audit-host, audit-action-filter, audit-type-filter, audit-tbody with 50 initial rows; changing action filter to status_changed reloads and shows filtered rows. Known flaky test: test_laravel_crm.py::TestQualify::test_qualify_updates_score_status (shared fixture mutation) — expected per review_request, NOT a regression.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in Section T. The single flaky failure is pre-existing and documented.
